statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring)
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73 and I25.10
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies
